activity.notes: Lý Công Uẩn, posthumously Lý Thái Tổ, was enthroned in 1009, founded the Lý dynasty, and ruled until 1028. ATLAS reuses Đại Cồ Việt for this reign; the state name Đại Việt was adopted only later, in 1054.

sources.title: Building a scientific dossier to submit to UNESCO to honor historical figure Ly Cong Uan
sources.citation_text: The Vietnamese cultural article identifies Lý Công Uẩn as Lý Thái Tổ, founder of the Lý dynasty, enthroned in 1009 and ruler of Đại Cồ Việt until his death in 1028.

sources.title: Lý Thái Tổ — biographical reference
sources.citation_text: The biographical chronology gives Lý Thái Tổ's reign as 1009–1028 and identifies him as founder of the Lý dynasty.
